# Increment 59i schema-17 targeted dispatcher

This recovery-only controller dispatches exactly the four workflows affected by
the qualified schema-16 diagnostic-order repair and schema-17 59f scheduling
partition: WA08, Combined, 59h, and 59f. It binds the successful 25-command
schema-17 source qualification and current-target reconciliation artifacts,
the exact candidate workflow bytes, the four preserved predecessor failures,
and live PR/feature/target refs before recording intent and issuing any POST.

It cannot dispatch full CI, update refs, merge, or mark roadmap acceptance.
